stem.text: A wedge-shaped metal conductor of length $L$, varying width and uniform thickness is connected to a cell, as shown.

stem.alt: Wedge-shaped metal conductor drawn as a shaded trapezoid with ends labelled X and Y, a horizontal double arrow labelled L beneath it, connected by wire to a cell.

stem.text: Which graph best shows how the average drift velocity $v$ of electrons in the conductor varies with distance $x$ from end X?

A.alt: Graph of v against x: a curve falling from the v axis to the right, ending before L on the x axis.

B.alt: Graph of v against x: a curve rising from a point above the origin, ending at L on the x axis.

C.alt: Graph of v against x: a straight line falling from the v axis to the x axis at L.

D.alt: Graph of v against x: a straight line rising from the origin to a point before L.
